title: Derive operation impact and fail closed

preReviewWarnings: Do not infer a requester's intent or label it malicious; derive decisions only from operation facts, repository evidence, authorization bindings, and actual diff evidence.
No reference-impact record may be treated as success when operation evidence shows an impact-bearing change.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A deterministic operation-impact assessment derives create, modify, overwrite, delete, rename, move, replacement, public API/configuration, test/CI, permission, schema, and release-impact facts from raw request, Contract declarations, and changed paths without assigning subjective malicious intent.

A structured evidence-conflict report blocks claims contradicted by repository, authority-binding, Contract, or actual-diff evidence, and verbal confirmation cannot override an unresolved factual conflict.

Reference-impact analysis supports file, directory, package, module, build module, public API, configuration, database schema, serialization format, CLI interface, and workflow targets; Maven parent/module/dependency/plugin/generated-source/test/CI relationships are analyzed for Maven modules.

Preflight reports not_ready when a declared or derived impact-bearing operation lacks the required usage, reference, compatibility/public API, test/CI, migration, rollback, authorization, or reference-impact evidence applicable to that operation.

The quality gate stops with needs_human_confirmation and an actionable recovery condition when impact-bearing changed paths have no covering reference-impact record; factual conflicts block, while no-impact changes remain not applicable on a fast path.
Actual Git diff evidence that contradicts Contract operation declarations fails closed before Finish and PR review.
Authority binding, request trust, safety evidence, and scope consistency are reported independently; effective decision is the strictest result.
Installer, upgrade, doctor, and adoption readiness verify every Makefile-referenced runtime script, schema, and policy bundle even when no evidence record exists.

Regression tests include the referenced Maven multi-module scenario, modify-versus-delete disagreement, missing evidence records, incomplete target coverage, ordinary no-impact change, test/CI weakening, and installer-missing-runtime cases.
Reference-impact documentation names generic and Maven analysis boundaries, missing-record human confirmation, fast paths, and the fact-based decision fields.
guidelines: New public APIs and operator-visible gate behavior must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from unrelated features.
Do not claim static analysis proves runtime or external-consumer absence.
Authority binding and safety evidence must remain separate decisions.

intent.problem: Reference-impact enforcement currently depends on an Agent proactively creating a record; a missing record prints a message and succeeds, so a Contract can omit destructive or compatibility-affecting classification without mechanically triggering evidence requirements.
constraints: Do not judge user intent or use suspicious wording as sole evidence.
Keep decisions deterministic and repository-local except for explicitly supplied authority evidence.
Block only factual conflicts; evidence gaps, bypass wording, and weak approvals must stop for a human decision with an actionable recovery condition.
Preserve a not_applicable fast path for ordinary low-risk changes.
Use test-first implementation and update both template-maintenance and installed Make entrypoints.
Deliver all mutually dependent classification, analysis, gate, installer, and adopter evidence in this single Work Item.
intent.rationale: A common operation-impact fact model, evidence-conflict report, target-aware reference analysis, and installer completeness gate let Preflight and post-change gates compare declared actions with objective evidence. Contradictory facts block; absent evidence becomes a visible human-decision stop rather than an implicit pass, without making low-risk changes slow.

rawUserRequest: 完成目标全部任务为止不要停，需要授权的，我授权给你，并写入Contract。WI跑完完整流程PR和清理（注意收敛方向，一旦发现无法收敛，就暂停整理完成以后再看）。最后自检，看看有没遗漏，如果有，循环修正到结束。全部没问题了，发布新版本。并要求 AI Cockpit 对删除、修改等操作依据操作、授权、仓库证据和实际变更判断，不凭感觉判断恶意。
